title: Giant found dead at a table with oysters in a sealed tower

tellings.quote: there was a giant seated at a table and he was dead.

plain: Sometime between 1978 and 1981, at Santa Anastasia in Sardinia, people opening a sealed tower are said to have found a giant sitting at a table, dead, with oysters in front of him. The filmmaker Tim Alberino passes this on from what he was told: "there was a giant seated at a table and he was dead."
